measures.what: overall diameter of the disc board
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: centre-to-centre spacing between the two small mounting holes near the centre, and each hole's diameter
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: length along the long side, width, and thickness; also centre-to-centre spacing of the corner holes (length and width)
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: height of the USB-C port's mouth (short side) and width of its mouth (long side); distance from the USB-C port mouth centre to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board; height of the ESP32 top face above the perfboard top face (with headers)
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: outer diameter edge to edge, laid flat on a table with a ruler or calipers across the LED face
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: thickness of the board itself (back face to LED face, not counting LEDs)
measures.reply: led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: board thickness, and the height of the tallest component (the capacitor or screw terminals) above the top face
measures.reply: perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.item: the two wall screws the box will hang on
measures.what: screw shank diameter, screw head diameter at its underside, and the centre-to-centre spacing between the two screws in the wall
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: thickness of the disc at the two mounting holes, including the LED package if the screws would pass through it
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk thickness: I can't measure that
